figures.caption: Alignment of open-reading frame nucleotide sequences of cloned cDNAs encoding feleucin-BV1 (FEL BV1) and feleucin-BV2 (FEL BV2) precursors. figures.caption: Region of reverse phase HPLC chromatogram of Bombina variegata skin secretion with arrows indicating elution positions/retention times of fractions containing peptides with molecular masses coincident with those predicted for the novel bombinin (arrow number 1), feleucin-BV2 (arrow number 2), and feleucin-BV1 (arrow number 3). The y-axis represents the absorbance in milliabsorbance units (mA) at λ 214 nm and the x-axis represents the retention time in minutes and seconds.
